raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misidentified the Wanli Emperor’s father as the Jiajing Emperor (Zhu Houcong) instead of the correct Longqing Emperor (Zhu Zaiji). This lineage error (Jiajing is Wanli’s grandfather) led to the wrong father-in-law for Wang Xijie. The Planner also briefly confused “father-in-law” roles (mixing the Emperor’s father-in-law with the Empress’s), and failed to verify the father on the Wanli Emperor page before concluding.
